question: 1 月 29 日到 1 月 30 日(台北時間)的總營收是多少?

answer.answer: 1 月 29 日到 1 月 30 日（台北時間）的總營收為 1246.00。
answer.basis: 使用 fact_orders 資料表，計算台北時間 2026-01-29 00:00:00 至 2026-01-31 00:00:00 之間所有訂單項目的 line_amount 總和。

raw_answer: {'answer': '1 月 29 日到 1 月 30 日（台北時間）的總營收為 1246.00。', 'value': '1246.00', 'status': 'answered', 'basis': '使用 fact_orders 資料表，計算台北時間 2026-01-29 00:00:00 至 2026-01-31 00:00:00 之間所有訂單項目的 line_amount 總和。'}

args.sql:
SELECT 
  SUM(line_amount) AS total_revenue
FROM iceberg.dwh_spark.fact_orders
WHERE ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei' >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-29 00:00:00'
  AND ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei' < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-31 00:00:00'

SELECT 
  ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei' as t,
  line_amount
FROM iceberg.dwh_spark.fact_orders
WHERE ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei' >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-29 00:00:00'
  AND ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei' < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-31 00:00:00'

SELECT 
  MIN(ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei'),
  MAX(ordered_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Taipei')
FROM iceberg.dwh_spark.fact_orders

SELECT 
  sum(line_amount) 
FROM iceberg.dwh_spark.fact_orders 
WHERE ordered_at >= timestamp '2026-01-29 00:00:00' 
  AND ordered_at < timestamp '2026-01-31 00:00:00'
